df_iowa

geo_iowa

    location=[42.03, -93.64289689856655],
    zoom_start=12, 
    tiles='cartodbpositron'
)
folium.Choropleth(
    geo_data = geo_iowa)\
    .add_to(map_iowa)

map_iowa
df_iowa

df_iowa = df_iowa.iloc[2:,:]

df_iowa
grade_mean = df_iowa.groupby('ACT Dist Code')\
               .agg(count_roof=('CRB % All Four', 'mean'))\
